name: Dancer'S Stretch
steps: Cross your right leg over your left, keeping the knee bent. Your left leg is straight and down on the floor.
Place your left arm on your right leg and your right hand on the floor.
Rotate your upper body to the right, and hold for 10-20 seconds. Switch sides.
coaching_cues: Maintain controlled form throughout the entire range of motion
Avoid using momentum to complete repetitions
